claims.claim: Skyworks reported $935 million in FY2026 Q3 revenue for the quarter ended July 3, 2026, and $49 million GAAP operating income, in its July 28, 2026 issuer earnings release.
In its FY2025 annual Form 10-K, Skyworks reported that sales linked to Apple accounted for 67% of aggregate FY2025 net revenue (69% in FY2024 and 66% in FY2023).

factors.name: Revenue baseline and customer concentration
factors.basis: Issuer financial results provide an observed revenue anchor; high single-customer concentration limits diversification inference and requires independent underwriting.

risks.risk: FY2025 Apple-related revenue concentration at 67% creates a substantial customer/channel dependency to examine; not independently scored.

unknowns.unknown: Issuer claims do not independently establish customer diversification, durable non-mobile growth, or investment-quality forecasts.

claims.claim: On July 28, 2026, Skyworks guided its September 2026 quarter to $1.010–$1.060 billion in revenue; this is management guidance at the time, not realized later results.
At the July 28, 2026 release date, the Qorvo combination was pending, not completed; an October 2026 closing must not be retroactively treated as known completed at the September 12 T0 cutoff.

factors.name: Management expectations versus execution
factors.basis: Guidance is a stated expectation requiring later realized-result comparison; acquisition outcome and synergies cannot be counted as already realized at T0.

risks.risk: Qorvo transaction financing/integration effects and revenue-guidance realization were uncertain at the T0 evidence cutoff.

unknowns.unknown: No independent source-backed proof of realized Q4 results or combined-company synergies at September 12, 2026.
